question: What is the meaning of disassembly companies in relation to end of life?
description: Disassembly companies specialize in taking apart products, especially those at the end of their life, to recover valuable materials and components. This process helps to conserve natural resources and reduce waste, aligning with circular economy principles. By carefully dismantling products, these companies can identify and reuse components that would otherwise be discarded, promoting sustainability and reducing the environmental impact of product disposal.
